heckles.message: Add screen shake, flashes, shot trails, wave clear slowdown, combo multiplier, and Printout and Amber skins
heckles.heckle:

Fix it: Add a reduce motion toggle for the shake and flashes and honor prefers-reduced-motion in index.html. Collapse the duplicated body[data-skin] h1 and .hud b selectors into one rule. Put the skin palettes in a single object instead of hand copying every variable. Ship fewer features per commit.

heckles.message: Ghost Wing v1

heckles.message: Add Centipede Text Edition v3

heckles.message: Ship gated Packet Baron build to the existing packet-baron page

heckles.message: Visual pass: nebulae, living Bloom edge, star tints and halos, ringed planet, engine trails, shot glow, shockwaves

Fix it: Make the status page in topo-wars-server-v1.html call a real health route that checks Redis. Rename the html file to something with no version in it. Put the final newlines back in README.md and CHANGELOG.md. Add a timeout so checking never sits there forever.

heckles.message: Prius: clean panel seams, smooth wheel arches, finer loft; Accord: air cleaner and valve cover under hood

heckles.message: Manual crawler: fetch with curl, log failures

heckles.message: Restore labels and info card in the render loop; label assemblies when the car is exploded
heckles.heckle:

heckles.message: Lane Listener drive-thru order listener
heckles.heckle:
Five hundred fifteen lines of index.html dumped in one commit, and the intern called it a drive-thru listener like it was a product launch. Every rule lives inline: the tokenize and parse functions, the price math, the learned aliases in localStorage, and the whole stylesheet crammed into one file with no tests. heckles.message: Raise the Raineurysm Puzzle score ceiling for twenty four levels

You bumped the score max for raineurysm-puzzle in api/_games.js from 60000 to 150000 by guessing, because there is no math or comment anywhere that says why 150000 and not 149000 or a million. Sort CHANGELOG.md so the newest entry is really first. Check that the README Latest change line matches the real newest entry.

heckles.message: Isometric lock shape mode
heckles.heckle:
Isometric lock mode, and the first thing you did was declare var isoLock=false in the middle of the file between helper functions like a campaign promise tossed into a budget bill. isoAxes returns two hardcoded arrays of radians typed by hand, and isoNext is a loop that matches angles with a 1e-6 epsilon, which is a fancy way of praying. heckles.message: Memory mode: replay rounds that learn from collisions
heckles.heckle:
A memory mode dropped into the same single index.html, because splitting files is apparently a government program you refuse to fund. You added a Memory button, then smeared a pile of globals across the file: memOn, memRun, memStart, memSeed, memRng, memRound, memT, scars, memRngs, memCur, memFix. The intern built a feature that learns from collisions and cannot learn from its own naming.

Fix it: Wrap the memory globals in one object so they stop polluting the file. Move the memCur side effect out of newPipe. Make the undo behavior in commit explicit when memOn is true. Add a way to switch Memory off cleanly. Give hashStr a comment or a test.

heckles.message: Cloth weave: over only single lines, under and stay under for bundles
heckles.heckle:
Four presets, basket, crochet, lace and doily, got their weave flipped from alternate to a brand new cloth string, and the commit message reads like a ransom note written by someone who lost the dictionary. heckles.message: Skin locked per map, heart and strip landmarks, city towers scale with district size

heckles.message: High scores: post each shift to the Score Hub, per task boards in the review and the menu
heckles.heckle:

heckles.message: Connector tiles for every edge combination and auto hole filling
heckles.heckle:
An IIFE that brute forces every four edge combination out of the letters C, R, F and W with four nested loops, then pushes filler tiles into DEFS at load time. It is clever in the way a lit match in a barn is clever. The weights are a magic .12 and the lake flag is a one line ternary nobody can read. Every page load now burns cycles building tiles that could be a static list. The nested loops use a, b, c and e as variable names, because apparently d was taken and imagination was not.

Fix it: Name the loop variables and the .12 weight in index.html. Build the connector list once and check it in instead of generating it on load. Add a test that no edge pattern is missing. Explain the lake rule in a comment.

heckles.message: City skin redrawn as detailed illustrations with cached tile art and lit 3D buildings

heckles.message: Circuit style with AC and DC boards, schematic parts and legend; Cyber, Color Pop and Escher Remix skins with new tile patterns
heckles.heckle:
Four new skins and a circuit style in one commit, all dumped into the same index.html like a spending bill with nine riders nobody read. heckles.message: Synth sounds with mute button, one way check valves, vault difficulty levels; shuffled vault chips; no stale clear cards after leaving Pipes
heckles.heckle:
This commit is five features and a bug fix wearing a trench coat. heckles.message: Tile Spinner Vault accepts difficulty-scaled scores up to 3000
heckles.heckle:
You raised the vault max from 1000 to 3000 and doubled perSecond to 200 in api/_games.js, which is a cheat code with a changelog. Anyone who can hit the score endpoint can now post a 3000 in two seconds and sit atop the board like a lobbyist at a committee hearing. heckles.message: Pipe styles (classic, water mains, streets, power lines) and Big boards in three sizes; hide vault panel outside Play
heckles.heckle:
Pipe styles and three Big board sizes in one shot, and the CSS grew pole, house, house-lit and pseg classes with colors sprinkled in as raw hex like #7a5a3a and #ffd23a. heckles.message: Vault: blank ring on every junction, five hide digits, the rest are decoys
heckles.heckle:
A blank ring on every junction and most of them decoys. Congratulations, you built a game where the main mechanic is clicking on nothing. The hint text now literally says most rings are empty decoys, which is you admitting the design needs an apology on screen. The vault-ring rule gained a transition on fill, stroke and opacity all at once, on every ring on a big board, which is a nice way to make a cheap phone cry. And the dashed .vault-spot.empty rings at 0.45 opacity will be nearly invisible outside, so players will be tapping fog.

Fix it: Drop the transition on stroke and opacity in .vault-ring in index.html for large boards. Raise the contrast of .vault-spot.empty so decoys are readable in sunlight. Rewrite the hint text so it explains the goal instead of confessing the design.

heckles.message: Post Rush, Pipes and Vault scores to the score hub; tap outside a card to close it
heckles.heckle:
You wired score posting into the game card with a three letter tag input, which means the entire leaderboard identity system is a text box and a prayer. No auth, no rate limit on the client, and a shared hub that now trusts whatever the page sends it. The .post-tag field is 76 pixels wide with letter spacing of 0.2em, which on a phone will clip a three letter tag like a cheap suit. Tap outside a card to close it also means a stray thumb during a score entry throws the whole run away. Nice touch for the intern who loves lost data.

Fix it: Do not close the card in the index.html tap handler while the .post-tag input has focus or text. Add a client side cooldown on the score post. Widen .post-tag so the letters are not clipped. Make the server in the score hub reject empty tags.

heckles.message: Register Tile Spinner rush, pipes and vault boards
heckles.heckle:
